summary: NXT Energy Solutions Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K containing a Report of Voting Results from its annual meeting of shareholders held on June 9, 2026. The report covers the election of directors and the approval of an auditor, an Employee Share Purchase Plan, Unallocated Entitlements, and a Preferred Share resolution. All matters were carried with over 99% support. No special situation event (e.g., acquisition, activist campaign, strategic review) is present; this is a routine post-meeting disclosure. No deal terms exist. The filing has no risk-arb angle.
